name: admin-auth-verify-id-token-errors
description: firebase-admin/auth verifyIdToken rejection modes and error codes across non-string input, empty string, malformed JWT, missing kid, non-RS256 alg, wrong project audience, wrong issuer, and tampered RSA signature on a real Firebase ID token.

nonStringToken.message: First argument to verifyIdToken() must be a Firebase ID token string.

emptyStringToken.message: Decoding Firebase ID token failed. Make sure you passed the entire string JWT which represents an ID token. See https://firebase.google.com/docs/auth/admin/verify-id-tokens for details on how to retrieve an ID token.

malformedJwt.message: Decoding Firebase ID token failed. Make sure you passed the entire string JWT which represents an ID token. See https://firebase.google.com/docs/auth/admin/verify-id-tokens for details on how to retrieve an ID token.

missingKidJwt.message: Firebase ID token has no "kid" claim. See https://firebase.google.com/docs/auth/admin/verify-id-tokens for details on how to retrieve an ID token.

wrongAlgorithmJwt.message: Firebase ID token has incorrect algorithm. Expected "RS256" but got "HS256". See https://firebase.google.com/docs/auth/admin/verify-id-tokens for details on how to retrieve an ID token.

wrongAudienceApp.message: Firebase ID token has incorrect "aud" (audience) claim. Expected "another-project" but got "<projectId>". Make sure the ID token comes from the same Firebase project as the service account used to authenticate this SDK. See https://firebase.google.com/docs/auth/admin/verify-id-tokens for details on how to retrieve an ID token.

wrongIssuerJwt.message: Firebase ID token has incorrect "iss" (issuer) claim. Expected "https://securetoken.google.com/<projectId>" but got "https://example.com/issuer". Make sure the ID token comes from the same Firebase project as the service account used to authenticate this SDK. See https://firebase.google.com/docs/auth/admin/verify-id-tokens for details on how to retrieve an ID token.

tamperedSignatureJwt.message: Firebase ID token has invalid signature. See https://firebase.google.com/docs/auth/admin/verify-id-tokens for details on how to retrieve an ID token.
